parameters.name: audioSources
parameters.description: Audio single source or an array of sources. Audios will be in a playlist if multiple sources are provided.

parameters.name: backgroundImageSource
parameters.description: URL for the background image source.

parameters.name: coverImageSource
parameters.description: URL for the cover image source. If not provided, text content will be left aligned.

parameters.name: headerTitle
parameters.description: Title text to render in the header.

parameters.name: headerSubtitle
parameters.description: Subtitle Text to render in the header.

parameters.name: headerAttributionImage
parameters.description: URL for attribution image or logo source (PNG/vector).

parameters.name: sliderType
parameters.description: Determinate for full control of the slider with transport control. Indeterminate is an ambient progress bar with animation.

parameters.name: bellUrl
parameters.description: Base URL of the skill's doorbell on the LAN (see the skill's bell.py); empty turns the bell off, and the page polls instead.

parameters.name: bellPage
parameters.description: The skill's id for this page, in its bell URL.

parameters.name: startOffset
parameters.description: Where the current track starts in the page's video (ms), if the skill knows when it builds the page; the first refresh sets it too.

parameters.name: startDuration
parameters.description: The current track's length (ms), as startOffset.

parameters.name: albumText
parameters.description: The album, on its own line below the artist.

parameters.name: primaryTextSize
parameters.description: How long the title is: 0 short, 1 long, 2 longer. Longer ones show smaller.

parameters.name: startShuffleOn
parameters.description: The first shuffleOn, if the skill knows it when it builds the page; -1 hides the button until the first refresh.

parameters.name: startRepeatMode
parameters.description: The first repeatMode, if the skill knows it when it builds the page; -1 hides the button until the first refresh.

parameters.name: startSongFavorite
parameters.description: The first songFavorite, if the skill knows it when it builds the page; -1 hides the button until the first refresh.

parameters.name: startAlbumFavorite
parameters.description: The first albumFavorite, if the skill knows it when it builds the page; -1 hides the button until the first refresh.

handleTick.description: At the end of MA's queue (video ms, set by the skill on its last track) pause, so the Show doesn't ask for the ended stream again; the video's onPause tells the skill. Here, not in the skill's commands: those can't read this component's binds. Tick handlers run in fast mode, which drops SendEvent.
A new bell URL every second, so the hidden bell image loads again. One SetValue changes the URL: it carries the tick and the video position.
Up next fades in for the song's last 20 s. A tick, not a bound opacity: only commands animate. AnimateItem on its own sequencer: tick handlers run in fast mode, which skips it.
Faint again for the next song, or after seeking back.

onMount.description: Without a doorbell the page polls: a MetadataRefresh, whose answer asks for the next one.

items.description: Main background: the cover, blurred and faint over black, so the page stays dark.
Music Assistant's logo, top right. Our own Image: the header doesn't show its attribution image here.
A clock, top left: the Show's own local time, so it ticks without the skill. Not on small round screens.
Dark panel behind title and artist, readable on any background.
The title when it is long: smaller, so it fits in its lines. Small screens show one line anyway.
The title when it is longer still: smaller again.
The album: one line, smaller and dimmer than the artist. None on the round screen, or without an album.

Up next: the next song's cover and title, a card of its own above the track bar. Floats over the cover row's bottom right, so it takes no room (the page's middle is centred: a taller one cuts the title). Invisible without a next song.
A hidden Video component to play the audio.

The doorbell (see the skill's bell.py): a hidden image the Show reloads from the skill over the LAN. An error answer means news: the page pulls it. Visible (but transparent): the Show may not load an image it doesn't draw.

onFail.description: On its own sequencer: onFail runs in fast mode, which drops SendEvent, but a command with a named sequencer runs in normal mode (APL core Sequencer::execute). The skill's commands and the buttons only reset the main sequencer.

items.description: Dark panel behind the track bar, times and buttons, readable on any background.

Pause asks the skill, whose answer pauses the video and MA (a page that paused itself on the tap has stopped sending events); play goes through MA, which sends a stream from the paused position. The play branch comes first: a pause flips videoPlaying, and a play branch after it would run too.

item.description: Two icons: a graphic's source may not follow a bind.

items.description: Covers the page after next/previous until MA opens the new track; swallows taps.
